from typing import List

def move_one_ball(arr: List[int]) -> bool:
    """Determine if array can be sorted non-decreasing by any number of right shifts."""
    n = len(arr)
    if n <= 1:
        return True

    # Count "breaks" where order decreases when traversing circularly
    breaks = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] > arr[(i + 1) % n]:
            breaks += 1
            if breaks > 1:
                return False

    # If no breaks, already sorted; if exactly one break, a rotation sorts it
    return True
